svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
the two Es, 43 apart: carved R and R, forcing key letters J and J
each known letter is enciphered in its own place, then rows of 7 carry it up to where it is carved
the shortest secret word, over every route and way of using the table
the shortest survivor of some route
OUT: NO READING; NO PUZZLE WORD FITS THE FORCED LETTERS
